canDoYue: 你識講批量數量、刻標誌、交貨期，同埋請對方用電郵報價同講價。
canDoEn: Order gifts in bulk, ask about engraving a logo and the lead time, and request a better price and an email quote.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning. Are you looking for a bulk quantity of small gifts with your own logo on the lid?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。你係咪想訂一批細禮品，盒蓋上面有你自己嘅標誌？
dialogue.say: Good morning. Are you looking for a bulk quantity of small gifts with your own logo on the lid?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes. We need thirty pieces for the office this month, and we want that logo engraved on each box.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。公司今個月要三十件，每個盒都要刻上個標誌。
dialogue.say: Yes. We need thirty pieces for the office this month, and we want that logo engraved on each box.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The engraving takes a little longer than we hoped, so the lead time is three full weeks from approval.
dialogue.glossYue: 刻字要比我哋諗嘅耐少少，交貨期由確認起計三個星期。
dialogue.say: The engraving takes a little longer than we hoped, so the lead time is three full weeks from approval.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you do a better price for all thirty pieces if we confirm the artwork with you this week?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我哋今個星期同你確認圖稿，三十件可唔可以平少少？
dialogue.say: Could you do a better price for all thirty pieces if we confirm the artwork with you this week?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I can gladly send a written price by email to you before the end of the full working day.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以喺收工之前用電郵寄一份書面價錢畀你。
dialogue.say: I can gladly send a written price by email to you before the end of the full working day.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please email the quote straight to our office, and please include the full lead time in that same note.
dialogue.glossYue: 請把報價直接電郵去我哋公司，同一張紙寫明成個交貨期。
dialogue.say: Please email the quote straight to our office, and please include the full lead time in that same note.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I will hold these small trays here in the shop once you approve the artwork and the written note.
dialogue.glossYue: 你確認圖稿同書面說明之後，我就喺舖頭留住呢批細盒。
dialogue.say: I will hold these small trays here in the shop once you approve the artwork and the written note.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will read it tonight with care and reply if the new schedule suits the whole office team well.
dialogue.glossYue: 我今晚會用心睇，如果新時間適合成個團隊，我就回覆。
dialogue.say: I will read it tonight with care and reply if the new schedule suits the whole office team well.
